claims.claim: young perch were present in Crystal Lake, Wisconsin, only in 1981-82, 1986-87 and 1990-91
claims.note: Full text not obtained. The abstract (not a confirmation) says YOY 'were caught in 1981-1982, 1986-1987, and 1990-1991, whereas few to no YOY were caught during the midyears' — so 'only' overstates it slightly ('few to no').

claims.claim: yellow perch in oligotrophic Crystal Lake, Wisconsin, formed three roughly five-year episodes of two dominant age classes
claims.note: Full text not obtained. The abstract says 'three cases of cohort dominance in which two age-classes dominated the population for roughly 5 years', since 1981, and attributes the cycles to cannibalism of YOY by juveniles or adults, pulses of reproductive adults, and competition between YOY and juveniles.
